description: This file implements security and authentication logic for a Messenger plugin within a WPEFramework-based project. It includes functions for token validation, ACL management, URL regex creation, and URL origin extraction, as well as the main token check method.

classes.name: Messenger
classes.description: A class providing security token validation and ACL management for a Messenger plugin.
